meta.scope: Descriptive only. GPT uses WorkBuddy runtime; Hy4 and MiMo use API. No cross-track significance or causal ranking.

definitions.sample_sd: Sample SD of round pass rates, ddof=1; not a standard error
definitions.mean_pairwise_flip_rate: Mean disagreement fraction across all three round pairs
definitions.mixed_rate: Fraction of items not unanimously pass/fail across the three rounds

limitations: Checkpoints and conditions are not independent personas
Fixed assertions have known false positives/negatives
Runtime wrapper and technical retries differ from API sampling
Not a completed execution-trace read audit
No latency, cost or CFI comparisons
